_comment: 🔁️ The GraphQL documents the read verbs of the repo CLI issue, executed against the frozen repository in 🗄️repo-records.json. A vector states the document a verb builds and the identifying members its three renderings must carry, so a drift in either the verb's document or a renderer is a red test.

vectors.query: query Tickets { repo { tickets { id slug title status prompt } } }
query Goals { repo { goals { id title status dueDate description } } }
query Bundles { repo { bundles { id name root sourceRoot kind } } }
query Folders { repo { folders { id path name kind } } }
query Files { repo { files { id path name kind extension } } }
query Contributors { repo { contributors { id emails name } } }
query Statutes { repo { statutes { id priority autofixable reason solution } } }
query Todos($filter: FilterInput) { todos(filter: $filter) { id name description } }

query Analyze($scope: String) { analyze(scope: $scope) { breachs { id summary scope line column excerpt kind { id priority autofixable reason solution } } metrics { total autofixable byPriority { high medium low } } } }
